subject: Re: Dedicated pool proposal + competitive pricing request
messages:
From: Alex Gross <agross@cerebrahealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated pool proposal — match request and SLA questions

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the draft proposal. A few points from our side before we lock in the 6‑month reserved commit:

- We have a competing offer from VectorScale that is ~18% cheaper on unit token pricing with a similar committed GPU pool. Can Redwood match or provide a competitive concession?
- We need 99.9% regional throughput guarantees during our peak windows (weekday 09:00–18:00 ET).
- Due to a delayed integration (our side), we’re asking for a one‑time onboarding credit to offset the first month of overprovisioning.

Attached is our updated SOW and a rough usage ramp. If you can propose an actionable concession (credits + adjusted rate), we can move to signature quickly.

Alex
Alex Gross
VP AI Platforms, Cerebra Health
agross@cerebrahealth.com

Attachment: Cerebra_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Alex Gross <agross@cerebrahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jan 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool proposal — match request and SLA questions

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I’ll escalate the competitive match to leadership and finance.

Quick notes:
- We can consider a one‑time onboarding credit plus a constrained discount on the committed pool if we can get a 12‑month minimum term instead of 6 months (that materially improves unit economics).
- Throughput SLOs (99.9% in region) are possible with a tailored dedicated pool + traffic shaping; we’ll need to confirm latency tail numbers once we see the token distribution.

I’m attaching a preliminary pricing workbook that shows a couple of concession scenarios (conservative vs. aggressive). Can you confirm expected peak qps and the token/sequence length distribution next week?

If it helps, I can get back with an escalation note to leadership by Monday after I sync with finance.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Feb 2027 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Cerebra pricing — request for discount exception / greensheet

Priya — forwarding the Cerebra thread. Summary of ask: competitive match (~18% delta), 6‑month reserved commit requested, asks for onboarding credit.

Proposal from AE: recommend a targeted concession to close quickly: 10% off unit price + $40k one‑time onboarding credit, conditional on a 12‑month commit and standard data/privacy terms. That still leaves a gap to VectorScale but preserves margin.

I’ve attached a short concession summary and a draft greensheet that outlines the business rationale (strategic health account, reference potential, product roadmap alignment). Laura / Marcus — requesting exec signoff or guidance on threshold. If we need to exceed $50k in credits or reduce price >15%, this needs VP approval per policy.

Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: concession_summary.pdf (application/pdf)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cerebra pricing — request for discount exception / greensheet

Ben / Priya — reviewed the numbers. Short summary from finance:

- A 10% rate concession + $40k onboarding credit reduces target gross margin below acceptable levels for a 6‑month commit. If the customer will extend to 12 months, we can absorb the hit with a structure: 8% rate concession + $50k one‑time credit amortized over 12 months.
- Any >15% price reduction or credits >$75k require Exec/CEO signoff.
- Throughput SLA: finance needs the SLO tied to pool sizing and a penalty cap; suggest we offer 99.9% regional throughput with an SLA credit capped at 5% of monthly invoice — legal will craft exact language.

I’ve prepared a conservative greensheet recommendation (attached) that requests approval for up to $50k in onboarding credit and an 8% rate concession contingent on 12‑month committed term. It includes margin impact and churn assumptions.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: executive_greensheet_draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cerebra pricing — request for discount exception / greensheet

Team — I support Marcus’ conservative recommendation. Rationale: Cerebra is a strategic healthcare partner with a strong chance to become a marquee reference in the clinical vertical; small near‑term margin concession buys positioning and potential net new ARR.

Approval: I authorize a one‑time onboarding credit of $50,000 and an 8% rate concession on the committed pool, conditional on:
- A 12‑month minimum reserved commitment (no early termination without make‑whole within first 6 months)
- Signed SLO clause with 5% monthly invoice cap for SLA credits
- Legal to accept minimal language changes (no major indemnity shifts)

Ben / Priya — please prepare the greensheet for signature and the updated commercial term sheet. Marcus, once Priya confirms the usage ramp, please sign the final finance worksheet. I’m copying Legal for awareness, will route to Execs if anything exceeds these limits.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: executive_greensheet_signed.pdf (application/pdf)
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Alex Gross <agross@cerebrahealth.com>, procurement@cerebrahealth.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Final—Committed terms for Dedicated Pool (Cerebra Health)

Alex / Procurement — thanks for your patience. Per our internal review and exec approval, Redwood can offer the following to close:

1) Commercial terms
- Commit: 12 months reserved GPU pool (capacity profile per attached workbook)
- Rate concession: 8% off our standard committed unit price across the reserved pool
- One‑time onboarding credit: $50,000 applied to the first invoice

2) SLA & guarantees
- Regional throughput SLO: 99.9% for peak windows (weekday 09:00–18:00 ET).
- SLA credit: capped at 5% of monthly invoice for validated breaches; operational runbook and penalty language to be included in SOW.

3) Conditions
- Final commercial sheet and SOW to be signed (DocuSign link below).
- Terms contingent on 12‑month minimum committed term and acceptance of standard data/privacy terms.

Next steps: I’ve attached the updated pricing workbook and the greensheet approval. If this looks good, I’ll push the term sheet to DocuSign and target signature this week so we can schedule onboarding for March.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/sign/0a1b2c3d4e
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deals/DEAL-1247

Thanks — looking forward to closing.

Best,
